data.title: Manufacturing
data.tagline: Stable output, traceable quality, and changeovers that do not cost a shift.
data.overview: Discrete and process manufacturers are being asked to increase variety, reduce inventory, and prove quality — often on equipment that was designed for a narrower world. We help teams make the existing plant more capable before replacing it.

challenges.title: High-mix demand
challenges.description: More variants and shorter runs expose changeover and scheduling weaknesses.

challenges.title: Skills concentration
challenges.description: Critical knowledge sits with a small number of experienced operators and engineers.

challenges.title: Quality escapes
challenges.description: Inspection is disconnected from process context, so containment is slow.

image.alt: Automotive assembly line in a modern factory

solutions.title: Industrial Automation
solutions.tagline: Control architecture, robotics, and line integration engineered for uptime.
solutions.overview: Meridian designs and commissions automation systems that connect machines, safety, and production data into one dependable operating layer. We work backwards from the process: cycle time, quality, and maintainability come before hardware selection.

image.alt: Industrial robotic arm on an engineering bench

solutions.title: Smart Manufacturing
solutions.tagline: Traceability, OEE, and quality intelligence built on the plant floor.
solutions.overview: We turn production data into operating decisions. Our teams connect machines, quality systems, and people with a data model that reflects how the plant actually runs — then prove the value on one line before scaling.

image.alt: Automotive assembly line in a modern factory

solutions.title: Industrial Software
solutions.tagline: Operational platforms that turn machine data into decisions.
solutions.overview: We build focused operational software where off-the-shelf tools stop short: production portals, quality workflows, asset registers, and integration layers. Every interface is designed for the shift, not for a demo.
